## Build Failure Diagnosis

**Solution:** `BuildDiag.sln` (3 projects: `Core`, `Services`, `Api`)

### Root Cause (1 error, in `Services.csproj`)

`Services/UserService.cs` uses `Newtonsoft.Json` (`JObject` on line 22, `using Newtonsoft.*` on lines 2–3), but `Services.csproj` has **no `PackageReference` for `Newtonsoft.Json`**. The project only references `Core.csproj`.

**All 3 CS0246 errors** stem from this single missing dependency:

| Error | File | Line | Message |
|-------|------|------|---------|
| CS0246 | UserService.cs | 2 | `Newtonsoft` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | UserService.cs | 3 | `Newtonsoft` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | UserService.cs | 22 | `JObject` type not found |

### Cascading Failure

- **`Api.csproj`** depends on `Services.csproj` → its compilation (`Csc` task) was **never attempted** because `Services` failed first. `Api` did not fail on its own merits.

### Fix

Add the missing NuGet package to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

This single fix resolves all 3 errors and unblocks the `Api` project build.
